summary: Anticipatory bail granted to accused in property fraud case; dispute over genuineness of 1996 GPA and 2022 sale deed; high court found prima facie civil dispute requiring handwriting analysis; supreme court examines balance between custodial interrogation and bail conditions; alleged forgery of power of attorney and sale consideration below market value; bail conditions include specimen signatures and Rs.1.50 crore deposit; appeal challenges high court's anticipatory bail order.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 438 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment granting anticipatory bail set aside; bail order vacated and matter remanded to High Court for reconsideration.
